label: C · 左侧标签轨 + 一张焦点大卡 + 紧凑目录表
prompt:
Design a full-bleed web page for a Chinese university second-hand marketplace, rendered edge to edge at 1536×1024, no browser window, no address bar, no device frame, no desk. Show the page itself, never a screenshot of a browser.

VISITOR'S JOB: a student arriving to see what just came in, reading one lead item carefully, then scanning a compact list of everything else and clicking through to message a seller.

This composition varies the focal moment and the hierarchy of the same design language: one item is promoted to a large lead card, everything else becomes a compact single-line catalogue table, and the classification field becomes a left-edge tab rail.

STRUCTURE, named in order with scale relationships:
1. Top bar, full width, 64px tall: product name「校园二手交易平台」at left, semibold 18px; navigation at 14px (首页 / 发布 / 我的商品 / 消息 / 订单 / 个人中心); search input 260px and an unread-count badge at right. Hairline rule under the bar.
2. Left tab rail, 160px wide, below the top bar: eight classification entries stacked vertically, each rendered as a 4px solid colour bar on its left edge inside a very light tint field of the same hue, plus the Chinese label and count at 14px (教材书籍 2 / 数码电子 4 / 生活用品 3 / 运动户外 1 / 服饰鞋包 1 / 美妆护肤 1 / 乐器文具 0 / 其他闲置 1). The active entry's tint is noticeably deeper and its bar thicker, with ink text on top.
3. Lead card, spanning the full main width, about 300px tall: a large 1:1 product photograph on the left third (a used textbook photographed flat on pale grey seamless ground, plainly lit, no styling props); at the right two thirds a monospace catalogue code 「TP311.5/12」at 12px; the title 「九成新《数据结构（C语言版）》教材」at 26px semibold ink; a two-line description at 15px muted; the price ¥15.00 at 40px semibold ink with a small struck-through original price beside it; seller, credit score, campus and hand-over place on a 13px metadata line; and a solid ink primary button 「私聊卖家」 plus a secondary outlined button 「收藏」. A small ink label at the card's top-left reads 「刚刚上架」.
4. Below the lead card, a compact catalogue table of the remaining items, 56px row height, hairline rules between rows, columns left to right: monospace code (110px), title (flexible), price (110px, right-aligned, ink semibold), seller (110px), campus and hand-over place (220px), status label (90px). Eight rows fully visible and a ninth clipped at the viewport's foot to show the list continues.

PALETTE, exact: ground #F5F6F3; card surface #FFFFFF; subtle fill #E9EBE5; hairline rules #C9CCC4 at 0.5px; ink #1A1D19 for text and the solid primary button; muted #5C6159 for metadata; the eight classification bars #7A5A2E, #1F5A6B, #35603F, #6B6A2E, #7A4260, #8C3B5A, #3A4A7A, #5A5F58 over their light tints #F1EAE0, #E4EEF0, #E6EFE8, #EFF0DF, #F2E7EC, #F5E6EB, #E7EAF3, #ECEEEA used on the tab rail and as each row's 4px code colour. Status: 在售 #1A1D19 outline; 交易中 #7A5A2E half-fill.

TYPE: workhorse Chinese UI sans (PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei character), regular and semibold only; monospace (Consolas character) for codes, prices in the table and all statistics. No serif.

MATERIAL AND MOOD: library catalogue shelf and shelf-list printout — flat ink on paper, hairline ruled rows, monospace shelf codes, flat colour tabs. Calm, orderly, and readable at a glance; the density of a well-kept register rather than a shop window.

EXCLUDE: warm cream or beige backgrounds; serif lettering; terracotta, brick or signal-red accents; gradients; glassmorphism; large soft drop shadows; pill buttons; mascots or illustrations; paper-grain texture photographs; browser chrome; English interface labels; invented logos, ratings or statistics; marketing banners.

The page must read as a working product screen: the lead card's title and price legible at a glance, the table's ruled rows crisp, the tab rail legible, and the first viewport carrying navigation, the rail, the lead card, and at least eight table rows.
